AIMed.d31.s261.sentence: Using histidine-tagged recombinant PROTEIN0, we screened soluble forms of TNF-ligand proteins with immunoprecipitation.

AIMed.d31.s262.sentence: Here, we demonstrate that PROTEIN0 specifically binds two cellular ligands, PROTEIN1 (PROTEIN2 PROTEIN3) and PROTEIN4 (PROTEIN5/PROTEIN6).

AIMed.d31.s266.sentence: Our data suggest that PROTEIN0 inhibits the interactions of PROTEIN1 with PROTEIN2/PROTEIN3 and PROTEIN4, thereby suppressing PROTEIN5- mediated HT29 cell death.

AIMed.d31.s267.sentence: Thus, PROTEIN0 may play a regulatory role for suppressing in PROTEIN1- and PROTEIN2-mediated cell death.

AIMed.d38.s324.orig_sentence: The genes for MPIF-2/eotaxin-2 (SCYA24) and eotaxin-3 (SCYA26) are localized within a region of approximately 40 kilobases.

AIMed.d38.s329.orig_sentence: Eotaxin-3 was chemotactic for normal peripheral blood eosinophils and basophils at high concentrations.

AIMed.d38.s330.sentence: Collectively, PROTEIN0 is yet another functional ligand for PROTEIN1.

AIMed.d38.s331.sentence: The potency of PROTEIN0 as a PROTEIN1 ligand seems, however, to be approximately 10-fold less than that of PROTEIN2.

AIMed.d38.s332.sentence: Identification of PROTEIN0 will further promote our understanding of the control of eosinophil trafficking and other PROTEIN1-mediated biological phenomena.
AIMed.d38.s332.orig_sentence: Identification of eotaxin-3 will further promote our understanding of the control of eosinophil trafficking and other CCR3-mediated biological phenomena.

AIMed.d45.s390.sentence: A mutant form of human PROTEIN0 (PROTEIN1 PROTEIN2) that binds one PROTEIN3 PROTEIN4 PROTEIN5 (PROTEIN6 PROTEIN7) has been designed and characterized.

AIMed.d45.s391.orig_sentence: IFN-gamma SC1 was derived by linking the two peptide chains of the IFN-gamma dimer by a seven-residue linker and changing His111 in the first chain to an aspartic acid residue.

AIMed.d45.s392.sentence: Isothermal titration calorimetry shows that PROTEIN0 PROTEIN1 forms a 1:1 complex with its high-affinity receptor (PROTEIN2 PROTEIN3) with an affinity of 27(+/- 9) nM.
AIMed.d45.s392.orig_sentence: Isothermal titration calorimetry shows that IFN-gamma SC1 forms a 1:1 complex with its high-affinity receptor (IFN-gamma R alpha) with an affinity of 27(+/- 9) nM.

AIMed.d45.s393.sentence: The crystal structure of PROTEIN0 PROTEIN1 has been determined at 2.9 A resolution from crystals grown in 1.4 M citrate solutions at pH 7.6.
AIMed.d45.s393.orig_sentence: The crystal structure of IFN-gamma SC1 has been determined at 2.9 A resolution from crystals grown in 1.4 M citrate solutions at pH 7.6.

AIMed.d45.s394.sentence: Comparison of the wild-type receptor-binding domain and the Asp111-containing domain of PROTEIN0 PROTEIN1 show that they are structurally equivalent but have very different electrostatic surface potentials.
AIMed.d45.s394.orig_sentence: Comparison of the wild-type receptor-binding domain and the Asp111-containing domain of IFN-gamma SC1 show that they are structurally equivalent but have very different electrostatic surface potentials.

AIMed.d45.s395.sentence: As a result, surface charge rather than structural changes is likely responsible for the inability of the His111-->Asp domain of to bind PROTEIN0.
AIMed.d45.s395.orig_sentence: As a result, surface charge rather than structural changes is likely responsible for the inability of the His111-->Asp domain of to bind IFN-gamma R alpha.

AIMed.d45.s396.sentence: The AB loops of PROTEIN0 adopt conformations similar to the ordered loops of PROTEIN1 observed in the crystal structure of the PROTEIN2/PROTEIN3 PROTEIN4 complex.
AIMed.d45.s396.orig_sentence: The AB loops of IFN-gamma SC1 adopt conformations similar to the ordered loops of IFN-gamma observed in the crystal structure of the IFN-gamma/IFN-gamma R alpha complex.

AIMed.d45.s397.sentence: Thus, PROTEIN0 PROTEIN1 binding does not result in a large conformational change in the AB loop as previously suggested.

AIMed.d45.s398.sentence: The structure also reveals the final six C-terminal amino acid residues of PROTEIN0 PROTEIN1 (residues 253-258) that have not been observed in any other reported PROTEIN2 structures.
AIMed.d45.s398.orig_sentence: The structure also reveals the final six C-terminal amino acid residues of IFN-gamma SC1 (residues 253-258) that have not been observed in any other reported IFN-gamma structures.

AIMed.d45.s399.sentence: Despite binding to only one PROTEIN0 PROTEIN1, PROTEIN2 is biologically active in cell proliferation, MHC class I induction, and anti-viral assays.
AIMed.d45.s399.orig_sentence: Despite binding to only one IFN-gamma R alpha, IFN-gamma SC1 is biologically active in cell proliferation, MHC class I induction, and anti-viral assays.

AIMed.d45.s400.sentence: This suggests that one domain of PROTEIN0 is sufficient to recruit PROTEIN1 PROTEIN2 and PROTEIN3 PROTEIN4 into a complex competent for eliciting biological activity.
AIMed.d45.s400.orig_sentence: This suggests that one domain of IFN-gamma is sufficient to recruit IFN-gamma R alpha and IFN-gamma R beta into a complex competent for eliciting biological activity.

AIMed.d45.s401.sentence: The current data are consistent with the main role of the PROTEIN0 dimer being to decrease the dissociation constant of PROTEIN1 for its cellular receptors.

AIMed.d55.s481.sentence: Human PROTEIN0/PROTEIN1 is a functional ligand for PROTEIN2, PROTEIN3 and PROTEIN4, and constitutively expressed by hepatocytes.

AIMed.d55.s483.orig_sentence: Here, we investigated its receptor usage by calcium mobilization and chemotactic assays using mouse L1.2 pre-B cell lines stably expressing a panel of 12 human chemokine receptors.

AIMed.d55.s486.sentence: Consistently, PROTEIN0 was found to bind to PROTEIN1, PROTEIN2 and PROTEIN3 with relatively low affinities.

AIMed.d55.s489.sentence: In human liver sections, hepatocytes were strongly stained by anti-LEC antibody.
AIMed.d55.s489.orig_sentence: In human liver sections, hepatocytes were strongly stained by anti-LEC antibody.

AIMed.d72.s609.orig_sentence: A cellular protein that competes with SV40 T antigen for binding to the retinoblastoma gene product.

AIMed.d72.s610.sentence: Tumour-suppressor genes, such as the human PROTEIN0 (PROTEIN1), are widely recognized as being vital in the control of cell growth and tumour formation.
AIMed.d72.s610.orig_sentence: Tumour-suppressor genes, such as the human retinoblastoma susceptibility gene (Rb), are widely recognized as being vital in the control of cell growth and tumour formation.

AIMed.d72.s611.sentence: This role is indicated, in part, by the suppression of tumorigenicity of human tumour cells after retrovirus-mediated PROTEIN0 replacement.
AIMed.d72.s611.orig_sentence: This role is indicated, in part, by the suppression of tumorigenicity of human tumour cells after retrovirus-mediated Rb replacement.

AIMed.d72.s612.sentence: How PROTEIN0 acts to bring about this suppression is not clear but one clue is that the PROTEIN1 protein forms complexes with the transforming oncoproteins of several DNA tumour viruses, and that two regions of PROTEIN2 essential for such binding frequently contain mutations in tumour cells.

AIMed.d72.s616.orig_sentence: The apparent targeting of the RbAP46-Rb interaction by oncoproteins of DNA tumour viruses strongly suggests that formation of this complex is functionally important.

AIMed.d84.s712.sentence: Using the yeast two-hybrid system, a genetic assay for studying protein-protein interactions, we have examined and compared the interaction of the PROTEIN0 PROTEIN1 (PROTEIN2) and the PROTEIN3 (PROTEIN4) with their two known substrates PROTEIN5 and the PROTEIN6 PROTEIN7 (PROTEIN8).
AIMed.d84.s712.orig_sentence: Using the yeast two-hybrid system, a genetic assay for studying protein-protein interactions, we have examined and compared the interaction of the insulin-like growth factor-I receptor (IGF-IR) and the insulin receptor (IR) with their two known substrates p52Shc and the insulin receptor substrate-1 (IRS-1).

AIMed.d84.s713.sentence: We also mapped the specific domains of the PROTEIN0 and PROTEIN1 participating in these interactions.
AIMed.d84.s713.orig_sentence: We also mapped the specific domains of the IGF-IR and p52Shc participating in these interactions.

AIMed.d84.s714.sentence: Our findings can be summarized as follows: (i) the tyrosine kinase activity of the PROTEIN0 is essential for the interaction with PROTEIN1 and PROTEIN2, (ii) PROTEIN3 and PROTEIN4 bind to the PROTEIN5 in the NPEY-juxtamembrane motif, (iii) contrary to PROTEIN6, PROTEIN7 binds also to the major autophosphorylation sites (Tyr-1131, -1135, and -1136) of the PROTEIN8, and (iv) the amino-terminal domain of PROTEIN9 is required for its association with the PROTEIN10 and the PROTEIN11.
AIMed.d84.s714.orig_sentence: Our findings can be summarized as follows: (i) the tyrosine kinase activity of the IGF-IR is essential for the interaction with p52Shc and IRS-1, (ii) p52Shc and IRS-1 bind to the IGF-IR in the NPEY-juxtamembrane motif, (iii) contrary to p52Shc, IRS-1 binds also to the major autophosphorylation sites (Tyr-1131, -1135, and -1136) of the IGF-IR, and (iv) the amino-terminal domain of p52Shc is required for its association with the IR and the IGF-IR.

AIMed.d84.s715.sentence: We propose that (i) the PROTEIN0 and the PROTEIN1 share at least in part the same molecular mechanism underlying their interplay with their two substrates, PROTEIN2 and PROTEIN3, and (ii) PROTEIN4 interacts with the PROTEIN5 in a fashion that is different from that used by PROTEIN6.

AIMed.d84.s716.sentence: Finally, our data highlight the crucial role of the juxtamembrane domain in signaling by both the PROTEIN0 and the PROTEIN1.
AIMed.d84.s716.orig_sentence: Finally, our data highlight the crucial role of the juxtamembrane domain in signaling by both the IR and the IGF-IR.

AIMed.d212.s1837.sentence: Previous results have demonstrated that AT cells are hypersensitive to ionizing radiation and are defective at the G1/S checkpoint after radiation damage.

AIMed.d212.s1839.sentence: Here we show that PROTEIN0 binds PROTEIN1 constitutively in control cells but not in AT cells.

AIMed.d212.s1840.sentence: Our results demonstrate that the SH3 domain of PROTEIN0 interacts with a DPAPNPPHFP motif (residues 1,373-1,382) of PROTEIN1.

AIMed.d212.s1841.sentence: The results also reveal that radiation-induction of PROTEIN0 tyrosine kinase activity is diminished in AT cells.
AIMed.d212.s1841.orig_sentence: The results also reveal that radiation-induction of c-Abl tyrosine kinase activity is diminished in AT cells.

AIMed.d212.s1842.sentence: These findings indicate that PROTEIN0 is involved in the activation of PROTEIN1 by DNA damage and this interaction may in part mediate radiation-induced G1 arrest.
